explanation: The H221Y mutation does not substantially reduce efavirenz binding, as the predicted ddG of essentially zero indicates negligible thermodynamic penalty. Position 221 is located >43 Å from efavirenz and makes no direct ligand contacts, placing it too distant from the NNRTI-binding pocket to directly perturb drug binding through steric or electrostatic mechanisms. The loss of histidine's positive charge coupled with a modest increase in side-chain volume appears insufficient to propagate allosteric effects through the intervening protein structure to alter inhibitor recognition at this remote distance.
